description: Crop a video to an area, then turn it, then optionally scale it to an exact size. Takes video files. Needs FFmpeg.

Area.description: A rectangle of a picture, in pixels from the top left corner.

x.description: Left edge, in pixels from the left.

y.description: Top edge, in pixels from the top.

Size.description: A width and a height in pixels.

area.description: The part to keep, in pixels; rounded down to even numbers, as H.264 needs.

output_dir.description: Absolute folder for the results; default: the user's setting.

size.description:
Scale the result to this size at the end, e.g. 1080 × 1350 for an Instagram portrait post;
rounded down to even numbers, as H.264 needs.

name: video_crop
title: Crop
